turns.t: Hello. We've been trying for a baby for a year now and nothing has happened, so I wanted to talk about it.
Thank you for coming. A year is the point where we usually start looking into it, so you are right to ask. Is your partner with you? ~
No, he's at work. He said he'd come to the next one. ~
That's fine. Can you tell me about your periods? Are they regular?
Mostly. Every twenty-eight to thirty days, I'd say.
Any pain with the periods, or with intercourse?
Quite painful periods, yes. Intercourse is fine.
Have you ever been pregnant before?
No, never. This is the first time we've tried.
Any previous problems with your womb or ovaries, like cysts or fibroids?
My mother had fibroids. I've never been told I have any.
Do you smoke, or drink alcohol?
I don't smoke. I only drink a glass of wine at weekends, that's all.
Good. Today my colleague will take your blood pressure, pulse and weight. ~
If you sit here, I'll put the cuff on. ~
Okay.
Blood pressure 118 over 74, pulse 70, weight 62 kilograms, height 165 centimetres.
Thank you. Those are all good. Now I'd like to examine your tummy gently, if that's all right. ~
Yes, of course.
Your tummy is soft and not tender, and I don't feel any lumps.
Is that good? ~
Yes. I'd also like to do an internal examination, but I can do that at the next visit when you're more comfortable. ~
I'll note that for the next appointment. ~
There may be several reasons it hasn't happened yet. It could be ovulation, the tubes, the womb, or sperm, and it could be more than one. I can't say which today.
Could it be the painful periods? ~
It might, if there's a condition such as endometriosis, but I wouldn't want to guess without more information.
What happens next? ~
We'll arrange a scan of your pelvis, and blood tests for hormones. Your partner would also need a semen test.
I'll tell him. ~
Try to have intercourse every two to three days through the month, not just around ovulation.
Okay, that sounds easier. ~
And please start folic acid, 400 micrograms a day, as soon as you can.
I'll buy some on the way home. ~
Good. The scan and bloods come first, then we'll talk at the next visit. ~
Thank you, doctor. ~
